name: Mistpelt Lynx
summary: A pale lynx whose fur takes on the color of whatever it crouches against.
description: Mistpelt lynxes hunt from low branches, dropping onto passing prey with barely a rustle. Their pelts are worthless once the cat is dead; the color drains out of them within the hour.

traits.name: Chameleon Pelt
traits.text: While the lynx is motionless in a forest, it has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and creatures have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice it.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: If the lynx moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {dc:str} Strength saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition. If the target has the Prone condition, the lynx can make one Bite attack against it as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lynx makes one Claw attack and one Bite attack.
